products.body_html: # Foam Cutting Pen 1. Fast heating for easy operation 2. Cut foam blocks from any angle to shape as needed 3. Smooth, rapid cutting; clean sealed edges without debris 4. Ergonomic non-slip handle for comfortable, stable grip 5. Ideal for cutting, carving and lettering on polystyrene foam ## Specifications Material: Nickel-Chromium Alloy Room temp resistance: 20 Ohms Max working temperature: 1500°C Application: Insulation foam cutting ## Important Notes 1. Pen tip length may slightly differ due to production batches. 2. Single continuous working time ≤30 mins; cumulative usage ≤2–3 hours. 3. Heating tube can only be bent ONCE; repeated bending at the same spot causes breakage. 4. Only suitable for medium & low-density foam; NOT for high-density foam or mass production cutting. 5. Switch off power after use to extend service life. 6. Items undergo power test before delivery; minor foam residues on pen body are normal. 7. Different-length heating pens cannot be mixed with mismatched power adapters, which leads to failure to heat or burnout. 8. For long-hour heavy work, select desktop foam cutting machine instead. ### Power Supply Comparison - Electronic Transformer: Low cost, lightweight and portable. Vulnerable to voltage surges, higher environmental requirements. - Full Copper Linear Transformer: Highly durable, only likely damaged by overload, but higher cost. ### Foam Cutting Pen VS Desktop Cutting Machine **Foam Cutting Pen** Portable; short single operation time; flexible hand shaping for right-angle corners. **Desktop Cutting Machine** High power, replaceable heating wire, low long-term cost and fast cutting. Produces ultra-smooth burr-free cuts. Compatible with high/medium/low-density foam, sponge, KT board. Supports prolonged work. Avoid overnight standby to protect transformer. ## Tip Mark heating tube corners to improve bending precision. Sample shape: 8.5\*4.5cm rectangle and rounded rectangle.

The head, back and sides of this acoustic violin are all made from basswood while the fingerboard, tailpiece, pegs, and chin rest are made from blacked wood and the bow is made from arbor and horse tail. Note: 1. When you receive the violin, please notice that the bridge is wrapped in paper and stowed underneath the tailpiece. Don't discard it. It should be installed in the middle of the two F Holes. 2. When you receive the bow and the hairs are loose, don't worry. Use the screw to tighten the frog so that the hair has tautness. 3. When you find that part of the bow hair is broken, it is normal, please cut off the broken part and the bow can be used normally. 4. Be careful to not over tighten your bow. The hair should have a slight bounce to it without touching the stick after placing it on the strings. Usually about 1/4 of an inch distance from the low point of the curve to the hair is ideal. 5. Hold the rosin with your index finger and thumb, and thus tighten up the bow, evenly smear the rosin on the bowstring up and down. Suggested use: before smearing, rip a trace on rosin to make it powdery for quick and even smearing. Try to keep your hands away from rosin or pad with a tissue while smearing; otherwise it will become too sticky to clean. 6. If the string falls out, don't worry, it can be reinstalled, please consult customer service.

products.body_html:
Specification

Product Information 

Product Type :Combo Item

Product Name:Dustbin Box with Planter Box, Vertical Wood Grain Panels, Long-Hole Cracked Ventilation, Iron Garden Storage Cabinet with Lock

Place of Origin:China

Main Color:Black

Main Material:Iron

Product Dimensions

Assembled Length (cm):131.00

Assembled Width (cm):79.00

Assembled Height (cm):120.00

Package Size

Sub-item 1: N621P398919SPackage Quantity: 1140.7 * 14.1 * 10.59 cm 19 kg

Product Features

  • Integrated Planter Box at the Top – Storage & Landscaping in One: The box has an integrated planter box on the top where you can directly place flowers and greenery. It perfectly combines garbage can storage with garden design, making your garden cleaner and more visually appealing.
  • Vertical wood veneer and narrow air vents – stylish design and fresh air: The front impresses with a vertical wood veneer that combines the warm feel of wood with the cool feel of metal to create a modern, minimalist design. Narrow ventilation slots on the bottom and sides ensure optimal air circulation inside and thus effectively reduce odor.
  • Separate compartments for convenient waste separation – Flexible use: The waste bin is divided into two separate compartments, each with space for a waste bin. This makes it easy to separate residual waste and recyclable materials. The waste bin is suitable for different environments such as home gardens, terraces, commercial spaces or residential complexes.
  • Anti-rust iron material – durable & weatherproof: The main body is made of iron material with an anti-rust coated surface. It is waterproof, sunproof and corrosion-resistant, resists outdoor wind and rain, and retains its stability and shape even with many years of use.
  • Single lock per door & security chain – safe handling: Each door is equipped with its own lock to protect pets from rummaging, trash scattering and unauthorized access. The integrated security chain limits the opening angle of the doors, ensures stability when opening and makes it easier to load and unload the garbage cans.

products.title: Floral Lace Cut-Out Maxi Dress With Thigh-High Slit
products.body_html:
Product Details

Overview

The Nocturne Lace Gown is a masterpiece of dark romanticism and modern allure. Crafted from intricate floral guipure lace, this floor-sweeping silhouette features daring waist cut-outs and a dramatic thigh-high slit, balancing modest high-neck tailoring with contemporary edge. Designed for high-profile evening events, it creates a statuesque profile that is both timeless and provocative.

Design Features

  • Neckline: Elegant high-standing mandarin collar for a refined, regal look.

  • Sleeves: Delicate cap sleeves that provide minimal coverage while maintaining a structured shoulder line.

  • Cut-Outs: Symmetrical side-waist cut-outs designed to accentuate the natural curve of the waist.

  • Skirt: A slim-fit maxi skirt featuring a bold front slit for ease of movement and a hint of skin.

  • Back: Secure zip-back closure for a seamless, tailored fit.

Specifications

  • Material: Premium Corded Floral Lace (100% Nylon/Polyester blend).

  • Lining: Integrated nude-toned partial lining for a sheer-effect contrast and optimal coverage.

  • Stretch: Minimal stretch to maintain the structured lace pattern.

  • Length: Full-length maxi (approx. 60 inches from shoulder to hem).

Size & Fit

  • Fit: Slim fit through the bodice and hips. We recommend sizing up if you are between sizes.

  • Model Info: Model is 168cm, wearing a size Small.

Care Instructions

  • Professional dry clean only.

  • Store flat to avoid stretching the lace delicate fibers.

  • Keep away from sharp jewelry to prevent snagging.

Styling Tip

"Let the intricate lace be the focal point by pairing this gown with sleek pulled-back hair and statement gold drop earrings. Finish the look with minimalist black stiletto sandals for an elongated, elegant silhouette."

products.body_html:
Description:
With our rotary motor controller, raising and lowering your blinds will be a breeze. This controller is suitable for operating a rotary motor and features a 24/7 programmable timer function. You can easily set a weekly schedule or schedule it for a specific day. The control unit has six easy-to-use buttons and a large monochrome display. The integrated power supply operates on a 230-volt input. The controller is suitable for all standard tubular motors with two control wires (top/bottom), a live wire, and a neutral wire. Warnings: DO NOT swallow the battery – risk of chemical burns. This product contains a button cell battery. A swallowed button cell battery can cause severe internal burns and death within just two hours. Keep new and used batteries away from children. If the battery compartment does not close securely, discontinue use and keep it away from children. If you believe batteries have been swallowed or have entered a body part, seek medical advice immediately. This device is not intended for use by persons (including children) with reduced physical, sensory, or mental capabilities, or lack of experience and knowledge, unless supervised or instructed in its use by a person responsible for their safety. Universeller Bremsentlüftungs-Adapter mit 90°-Winkel, verstellbar 28–70 mm, Spezialanschluss für Bremsflüssigkeitsbehälter

 

Produkt-Highlights

 
90°-Winkel-Design: Optimiert für enge Räume, besonders flexibel und praktisch im Motorraum
 
Spezielle Dichtkonstruktion: Passt zu Bremsflüssigkeitsbehältern mit umgebogenem Rand, sorgt für dichten Anschluss während der Entlüftung
 
Schlauchanschluss mit Winkel: Einfacher Anschluss des Entlüftungsschlauchs, auch bei beengten Einbauverhältnissen
 
Hochwertiges Material: Aus langlebigem, bremsflüssigkeitsbeständigem Kunststoff gefertigt, hohe Lebensdauer
 
Einfache Bedienung: Werkzeuglose manuelle Verstellung, schneller Einbau am Behälter
 

Technische Daten

 
Produkttyp: Bremsentlüftungs-Adapter
 
Anschlussart: US-Standard-Anschluss
 
Winkel: 90°
 
Befestigung: Schnellverschluss mit umgebogenem Rand
 
Anschluss: Schnellanschluss mit Winkelschlauch
 
Abmessungen: ca. 18 cm × 11 cm × 9 cm (L×B×H)
 
Material: Ölbeständiger Kunststoff
 
Verpackung: Einzelverpackung
 
Zustand: Neu, unbenutzt
 

Lieferumfang

 
1 × Verstellbarer Bremsentlüftungs-Adapter (90°-Winkel-Design)
 

Anwendungsbereiche

 
  1. Bremsflüssigkeitswechsel: Anschluss an Entlüftungsgeräte, dichte Abdichtung des Behälters, Lufteintritt verhindern
  2. Bremsanlage entlüften: Nach Reparatur von Bremszylindern, Hauptbremszylinder oder Bremschläuchen
  3. Enge Motorräume: Ideal für Fahrzeuge mit begrenztem Platz im Motorraum
  4. Wartung von Mehrkolbenbremsen: Professionelles Hilfswerkzeug für Hochleistungsbremsen
  5. ABS-Reparatur: Entlüften und Druckprüfung nach ABS-Pumpenwechsel
  6. Oldtimer-Restaurierung: Passt zu nicht genormten Bremsflüssigkeitsbehältern
  7. Werkstattausstattung: Standardwerkzeug für Werkstätten und Autohäuser
  8. DIY-Pflege: Für Bremswartung am Privatfahrzeug, nutzbar mit Hand- oder Druckentlüfter
 

Bedienungsanleitung

 
  • Adapter auf die Einfüllöffnung des Bremsflüssigkeitsbehälters setzen und auf passenden Durchmesser (28–70 mm) einstellen
  • Sicherstellen, dass der Verschluss sicher am umgebogenen Rand einrastet und abdichtet
  • Entlüftungsschlauch an den Winkelanschluss des Adapters anschließen
  • Entlüften oder Befüllen der Bremsflüssigkeit durchführen
  • Nach Abschluss zuerst den Druck abbauen, dann den Adapter entfernen
 

Sicherheitshinweise

 
️ Vor dem Einsatz prüfen, ob der Durchmesser der Behälteröffnung 28–70 mm beträgt
 
️ Sicherstellen, dass der Behälter einen umgebogenen Rand hat, sonst ist kein fester Halt möglich
 
️ Zu starkes Neigen des Adapters während des Betriebs vermeiden, um Undichtigkeiten zu verhindern
 
️ Nach Gebrauch Bremsflüssigkeitsrückstände reinigen und trocken lagern
 
️ Nur für übliche Bremsflüssigkeiten DOT3/DOT4/DOT5.1 geeignet

The integrated safety chain limits the opening angle of the doors, ensures stability when opening and makes it easier to load and unload the garbage cans.

Product Features

  • Pure fun: This all-in-one solution combines an inflatable slide, paddling pool, basketball court, water guns, play kitchen and ring toss game to meet the diverse play needs of children.
  • Sturdy and Safe Construction: Reinforced, inflatable edges and a padded floor effectively reduce the risk of collision, making it suitable for use in gardens, lawns and outdoor activities.
  • New play opportunities in summer: Integrated water guns and a spray function on the slide as well as a large paddling pool allow children to have splashing water fun outdoors.
  • Social and educational interaction: Various games such as play kitchen, basketball and ring toss promote social skills and hand-eye coordination, stimulating imagination and creativity.
  • Easy to assemble and disassemble: Equipped with a powerful 580W blower, the device can be inflated quickly and conveniently. Thanks to the compact folding mechanism, it is easy to store and transport.

Descriptions

Long Description:

Made of sturdy, waterproof Oxford fabric, this inflatable water park for kids offers durability as well as a comfortable and safe play experience. With a powerful 580W blower, the castle can be inflated in just a few minutes, allowing children to quickly immerse themselves in a world of fun. It combines a slide, a paddling pool, water pistols, basketball hoops, a play kitchen and a ring toss game. This allows children to have fun in the cool water and at the same time experience various interactive games that promote their social skills and hand-eye coordination. The slide can be connected to a water spray system for even more refreshment. The sturdy construction and padding provide additional safety. Quick to set up and easy to store, the water park is perfect for family gardens, patios, or garden parties – the ideal choice for summer entertaining.

Note:

1.Not suitable for children under 3 years old. 2.The max. load capacity is 135kg, suitable for a maximum of 3 children. 3.Due to manual measurements, there is an error of a few centimeters. 4.The blower must be on all the time while the children are playing.

Machen Sie sich keine Mühe, die Batterie häufig zu ersetzen, was wirtschaftlich und umweltfreundlich ist. Stecken Sie den Adapter (5v / 2A) in einen Standardstecker an und schließen Sie dann den Steckdose "micro USB-Schnittstelle" auf der Breite an, um den Akku aufzuladen. Wenn der Akku voll geladen ist, kann das Hauptlicht nicht weniger als 35 Stunden lang kontinuierlich eingeschaltet sein.

Einzigartiges zusammenklappbares Design und einfach zu bedienen: Unsere Laterne wird durch die zusammenklappbare Struktur gesteuert, mit der Sie die Helligkeit ändern können, indem Sie die Höhe der Laterne einstellen. Sie können den oberen Teil nach oben ziehen oder nach unten schieben, um die Laterne an oder aus zu halten, sehr einfach zu bedienen. Nach dem Falten kann das Unterlicht nach Drücken des mittleren Knopfes auch als Taschenlampe verwendet werden. Die Griffe werden verwendet, um die Laterne an einem Baum oder einem Zelt zu hängen, um Ihre Umgebung zu beleuchten.

Descriptions

Classic thick flannel fabric, comfortable and versatile

The sofa is made of high-quality thick flannel, with soft texture and classic appearance. The fabric is skin-friendly, durable and not easy to fade. The neutral colours blend seamlessly with different interior styles – whether modern, rustic or minimalist, it gives your home a warm and cosy atmosphere. In addition, the thick flannel fabric is easy to clean: dust can be removed with a vacuum cleaner, light dirt can be carefully wiped off with a damp cloth.

High-density foam + suspension elements, long seating times without fatigue

Inside the sofa is high-density foam upholstery with high density and good rebound, combined with built-in spring elements. This combination makes for one that is soft but stable – not too soft to not support the body enough and not too hard to cause discomfort. It effectively reduces the strain on the spine, even when sitting or napping for hours on end. The spring elements also strengthen the stability of the sofa and extend its lifespan

Practical functional equipment, comfortable life

The sofa is equipped with large side compartments and integrated cup holders. The side compartments offer enough space for TV remote control, books, magazines, mobile phones or tablets - all within reach, without needing extra storage space. The cup holders prevent drinks from accidentally tipping over, ideal for movie nights, relaxation times or guest reception.

Comfortable for long working days

The sturdy construction and high-quality materials ensure a long lifespan even with intensive daily use. The cushions can be easily removed and cleaned separately (according to the material specifications). This sofa allows for long-lasting comfort without extensive maintenance - ideal for busy families or followers of a minimalist lifestyle.

Easy care in everyday life

In everyday life, we need furniture that is easy to maintain - and this sofa meets exactly that requirement! The thick flannel material is abrasion-resistant and resistant to light soiling. In case of dust, you can easily clean it with a vacuum cleaner; in the case of stains, wipe carefully only with a damp cloth - no time-consuming cleaning necessary.

Versatile applications, cost-effective choice

The compact sofa is suitable for almost any room and situation. Whether as a main seat in the living room, as a guest sofa in the guest room, as a work sofa in the home office or as an additional seating area for parties - it adapts flexibly. The simple and timeless design language does not make it obsolete quickly, and the high-quality materials ensure a long service life. Compared with traditional sofas, it is more space-saving and cost-effective, it does not provide less comfort.

products.body_html:
Redefine Winter Comfort with 360° Warmth. Why settle for a cold commute or freezing indoor drafts? The Virelleco 31-Zone Smart Heated Hoodie combines the cozy, everyday style of your favorite pullover with revolutionary heating technology. Designed for maximum coverage and powered by our included high-capacity battery, this is your personal, wearable microclimate.

Premium Benefits & Features

  • Epic 31-Zone Heating Coverage: Experience true full-body warmth. Unlike standard heated gear, our cutting-edge design features 31 strategic carbon-fiber heating elements that wrap around your back, chest, abdomen, and even down both arms, leaving no cold spots behind.

  • 4-Button Precision Control: You are in complete control of your comfort. The advanced 4-button smart switch allows you to independently heat your core, back, or arms. Turn on exactly what you need, when you need it.
  • High-Capacity Battery Included: Ready to go right out of the box! We've included a premium, long-lasting power bank featuring dual USB outputs. It delivers hours of uninterrupted warmth and can even double as a portable charger for your smartphone.
  • 3 Smart Heat Levels: Adjust to unpredictable weather instantly with a simple press. Choose from Low (77°F / Blue Light), Medium (95°F / White Light), or High (113°F / Red Light) to find your perfect temperature.
  • Everyday Style & Comfort: Built for daily life. Crafted from premium, breathable, and skin-friendly fleece fabric, it looks and feels like a high-end designer hoodie.
  • 100% Machine Washable: Easy to care for and designed to last. Simply remove the battery pack, zip up the pocket, and toss the hoodie into your washing machine on a gentle cycle.


How to Activate Your Heat

  1. Connect: Unzip the inner pocket and plug the built-in USB cable into your included power bank.
  2. Activate: Press and hold the main power button for 3 seconds until the LED lights illuminate.
  3. Customize: Press any of the 4 independent zone buttons briefly to cycle through the 3 different temperature settings.
  4. Power Off: Press and hold the button for 3 seconds to turn off the heating system.

products.body_html:
Product information:

Material: Edible Silicon (free of phenol A, lead, and known harmful substances), non-latex products, will not cause any allergic reactions to infants and children, you can use it with confidence!
Stage 1: in the budding stage, before the teeth grow out, the baby already feels uncomfortable on the gums. The gum of the first stage can be put in the refrigerator, and the cool touch can relieve the swelling and pain of the baby's gums before teething.
Stage 2: at the age of 6 months, most babies begin to grow a pair of incisors in the lower jaw. At this time, frozen gums massage soft incisors should be used to relieve discomfort; Hard gums can massage pulp, and uneven gum surface will also stimulate the development of baby's brain.
Stage 3: When the baby grows four upper and lower teeth, it is recommended to choose pacifier chewing gum which is similar in shape to pacifier, lighter in weight and easier to grasp. The soft and hard texture layer can not only massage the pulp around the newly grown teeth, but also let the baby experience the feeling of chewing.
The fourth stage: 1-2 years old. 1-2 years old is the growth period of deciduous teeth. Select the fixed teeth gums that can reach a wide range of teeth and have baffles to prevent contact with the throat. The texture layer mixed with soft and hard can reduce swelling and pain caused by big teeth, help to enhance tooth development and exercise chewing ability.
